notes: Both supplied locators and neutral description were empty; the primary replication report identifies the target original comparison. Original title and authors verified against the supplied reference; source is the author-hosted manuscript, with manuscript pagination. The supplied replication URL fgdxs identifies the DOCX report file, not an OSF project node; its project t9h6p matches the supplied reference. Neither source prints a named effect-size estimate or rank-biserial correlation for the target test; none was calculated. The replication report gives treatment means and SDs and calls the difference significant but does not explicitly state a narrative replication-success verdict; reported_success is therefore null rather than inferred from significance.
